notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.107

• Lock screen notifications: a new look (frosted cards with the app's name and time, the newest few, the rest stacked behind them), swipe a notification sideways to dismiss it, "Clear all", and tap one to open it right after you unlock.
• Face unlock waits for you: when your face is recognised, the padlock over the clock springs open and the lock screen stays until you swipe up.
• Fixed: holding an app and moving it very fast could leave an invisible copy of the app list over the home screen, which caught your touches.
• Fixed: DuckAI's voice could crash when it was stopped mid-sentence.
